DiagramService
|-- The public interface is the sole diagram content writer.
|   |-- Callers can create, revise, generate, fetch and list revisions.
|   `-- RevisionedDiagramService delegates edit preparation to DiagramRevisionEditor.
|-- The implementation issues records through the shared revision registry.
|   |-- Creation registers the prepared diagram and node references.
|   |-- Revision reads its base; an unchanged diagram reuses that revision.
|   `-- Changed revisions preserve diagram identity and record their parent.
|       `-- Node correspondence preserves existing references where possible.
|-- Generation uses an optional injected DiagramGenerator.
|   |-- The generator receives a cloned request and progress or abort options.
|   |-- A supplied base must belong to the requested local diagram.
|   `-- After generation and abort checks, the service calls revise or create.
`-- The service boundary separates local issuance from durable publication.
    |-- Revision lists and their summaries are frozen.
    `-- Registry and generator lifetime ownership is unspecified here.
